```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)

rm(list = ls())

```

# Add survival rates from HMD
```{r}
mortality_overview <- data.frame(
  country = c("AT", "BE", "BG", "CH", "CZ", "DE", "DK", "EE", "ES", "FI", "FR", "EL", "HU", "IE", "IS", "IT", "LT", "LU", "LV", "NL", "NO", "PL", "PT", "SI", "SK", "SE", "UK"),
  file = c("AUT", "BEL", "BGR", "CHE", "CZE", "DEUTNP", "DNK", "EST", "ESP", "FIN", "FRATNP", "GRC", "HUN", "IRL", "ISL", "ITA", "LTU", "LUX", "LVA", "NLD", "NOR", "POL", "PRT", "SVN", "SVK", "SWE", "GBRTENW"))

mortality = data.frame()

for (i in 1:nrow(mortality_overview)) {

  mortality_table <- read.table(paste0("data/hmd/", mortality_overview$file[i], ".cMx_1x1.txt"), skip = 3, header = F, na.strings = ".")

  colnames(mortality_table) <- c("cohort", "age", "female", "male", "total")

  mortality_table$country <- mortality_overview$country[i]

  mortality <- rbind(mortality, mortality_table)

}

mortality <- mortality %>%
  select(country, cohort, age, female, male) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(female, male), names_to = "gender", values_to = "mortality_rate") %>%
  mutate(gender = case_when(
    gender %in% c("male") ~ "Male population",
    gender %in% c("female") ~ "Female population"))

mortality$age <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(mortality$age))

survival <- mortality %>%
  filter(age >= 54) %>%
  arrange(country, gender, cohort, age) %>%
  group_by(country, gender, cohort) %>%
  mutate(survival = ifelse(age == 54, 1, 1 - mortality_rate)) %>%
  reframe(
    survival = cumprod(survival),
    age = age + 1)

survival <- survival %>% filter(cohort %in% c(1900:1990) & age %in% c(55:74))

rm(mortality_overview, mortality_table, mortality, i)

```

```{r}
prepare_sample <- function(data, ages, complete_until, exclude) {

data <- data %>% left_join(survival, by = c("country", "gender", "cohort", "age"))

data <- data %>% filter(age %in% ages)

data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    working_hours = ifelse(is.na(working_hours_usual), 0, working_hours_usual),
    working_hours = ifelse(working_hours >= 40, 1, working_hours / 40),
    weight = ifelse(is.na(weight), 1, weight))

# country-cohorts with at least 100 observations and max. 10% missings at each age
table <- data %>%
  mutate(missing_hrs = ifelse(status == "Employed" & is.na(working_hours_usual), 1, 0)) %>%
  group_by(country) %>%
  filter(cohort >= min(year) - min(ages)) %>%
  group_by(country, cohort, gender, age) %>%
  summarise(total = n(),
            missing_age = mean(is.na(age)),
            missing_sex = mean(is.na(gender)),
            missing_emp = mean(is.na(status)),
            missing_srv = mean(is.na(survival)),
            missing_hrs = mean(missing_hrs, na.rm = T)) %>%
  filter(total >= 100 & missing_age <= 0.1 & missing_sex <= 0.1 & missing_emp <= 0.1 & missing_srv <= 0.1 & missing_hrs <= 0.1)

table <- table %>% group_by(country, cohort, gender) %>% filter(n() == length(ages) | cohort > complete_until)

table$id <- paste0(table$country, "_", table$gender, "_", table$cohort)

data$id <- paste0(data$country, "_", data$gender, "_", data$cohort)

data <- data %>% filter(id %in% table$id)

data <- data %>% filter(!paste0(country, "_", cohort) %in% exclude & !country %in% exclude)

data <- data %>%
  select(country, country_code, country_group, gender, age, year, cohort, cohort_two, education, status, working_hours, working_hours_usual, survival, weight) %>%
  arrange(country, gender, cohort, age)

return(data)

}

```

# Age group 55 to 64
```{r}
data <- readRDS("outputs/lfs_55_64.rds")

data <- prepare_sample(data, ages = 55:64, complete_until = 1955, exclude = c("DK_1928", "DK_1929", "LU"))

saveRDS(data, "outputs/sample_55_64.rds")

rm(data)

```

# Age group 65 to 74
```{r}
data <- readRDS("outputs/lfs_65_74.rds")

data <- prepare_sample(data, ages = 65:74, complete_until = 1946, exclude = c("LU"))

saveRDS(data, "outputs/sample_65_74.rds")

rm(data)

```
